title: cynanchum collinum
intro: Cynanchum collinum, commonly known as Bhringaraj or false daisy, is a plant species in the Asclepiadaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to promote hair growth, improve skin health, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Cynanchum collinum include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, which help to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Cynanchum collinum include triterpenoid saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
